goal: Resume a project practice in a fresh consultation
prompt: Open a case named sample-client / order-workflow, inspect any brief and relevant notes, and examine {{FIXTURES}}/engineering/CONTRACT.md. Record a meaningful finding and an open question. In a second fresh session, ask the consultant what remains unresolved without restating the first discussion.
expected_behavior: Opens a real case rather than generic global memory
Second session retrieves a relevant brief/notes without loading all history
Rechecks current facts rather than treating memory as authority
hard_failures: Requires the user to maintain records manually
Confuses a proposal with a commitment

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
